# QuickyBricks: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-08 · code ed41d56db0bd · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Roll, doodle and hatch a giggly family of squishy 3D cubes. Hold hands with other players' cubes to make cube babies. A silly browser game to play with a grown-up.
**Live:** https://quickybricks.com · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/quickybricks · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/quickybricks/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py quickybricks` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **The 3D engine stays JavaScript.** `theme/assets/qb.js` = the old `web/pages/_qb.html` moved unchanged (game data,
  faces/thumbnails, sounds, d-pad, draw pad, three.js Stage/Actor, the roller); only change: `QB.keys` ignores arrow
  keys while an Anvil dialog is open (`body.modal-open`). `theme/assets/qb-play.js` = the glue: the `UI.api` /
  `UI.toast` the engine calls (through `window.QB_BRIDGE` in `client_code/qb.py`, whitelist `roll_cube`, `get_faces`),
  the stage controllers `QBP.hero` (landing playground, Maker preview, cube card), `QBP.cubby` (8x6 play mat),
  `QBP.world` (the island), and small drawings (`QBP.thumb`, `face`, `cubedex`, `poster`, `chatClean`).
- **Components/Stage** mounts a controller: `self.stage.mount(kind, data, hooks, pad=dom_node)`; it starts on the
  component's `show` and is destroyed on `hide` (browsers allow ~16 WebGL contexts). Hooks are Python functions the
  engine calls with JSON text (`onResult`, `onSelect`, `onPickOther`, `onChat`, `onNews`); the page calls back
  through `self.stage.ctl` (`setData`, `select`, `sync`, `celebrate`, `findEgg` ...). Check `self.stage.live()` first.
- **World**: `Pages/World` polls `get_world` every 3 s and hands each reply to `ctl.sync(json)`; `leave()` (called by
  router.show) stops the poll and the chat clock. The "can they hold hands?" text is `why_not()` there (same order
  as `World.hand_problem` on the server, which decides for real).
- **Browser storage keys are the JS version's** (`quickybricks.draft` = the landing cube the Cubby adopts after
  sign-up, `sel`, `wsel`, `pos.<user id>`, `mute`, `theme`). Read them with `qb.store_get` (UI.store.get gives a JS
  proxy, not a dict).
- `QB.roll` (qb.js) and `rules.roll` (server) must stay identical: the roller predicts, the server confirms.
- Server code is the old code; only type annotations were added for `anvil validate` (Accounts `changes: dict`,
  common `getattr(anvil.server, "session")`, rules `PROPS: list`).
- `tools/ui/smoke.js` opens every page (guest, member, admin) at desktop and phone width, rolls the playground cube,
  rolls a cube on the server, sends a cube to the World. Headless Chrome draws WebGL with SwiftShader (drive.mjs flags).
- ArkMusic: `theme/assets/ark-music.js` is a copy of APP_MAKER/media/public/ark-music.js written by tools/music_sync.py.
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
